Subject: MAP draft & post-call recap - AcuityHealth

Hi Erin - thanks again for the time this morning. Attached is the draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) we discussed plus a short pricing summary. I captured the key outcomes from the discovery and some suggested milestones so we can align on timeline and owners.

High-level recap / next steps:
- Objective: Proof-of-concept (pilot) of Redwood inference for clinical summarization across 2 pilot clinics (~5K queries/mo).
- Target close date for pilot agreement: 2026-03-31 (customer target).
- Dependencies: SOC 2 evidence, network allowlist for private endpoints, procurement PO + contract signature.
- Next immediate step: confirm MAP milestones and target close date by EOD Friday (3/6).

Draft MAP (in attached Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx):
1) Kickoff & SOW sign-off - Owner: AcuityHealth (Procurement) / Redwood - Target: 2026-03-10
2) Security review (SOC 2 + ISV questionnaire) - Owner: AcuityHealth SecOps / Redwood SRE - Target: 2026-03-15
3) Environment setup (VPC allowlist, keys) - Owner: AcuityHealth Infra / Redwood Private Ops - Target: 2026-03-18
4) Pilot validation & sampling - Owner: AcuityHealth Clinical Ops / Redwood CSE - Target: 2026-03-24
5) Pilot close and commitment decision - Owner: AcuityHealth Leadership / Redwood AE - Target: 2026-03-31

Open items we flagged on the call:
- Pricing: Erin requested discount/credits tied to committed volume - we flagged for exec review.
- Legal: standard Redwood terms will be sent; procurement asked about data retention and audit logs.

Asks for you (Erin / procurement):
- Confirm the milestones/owners above (or suggest edits).
- Tell us your target committed volume for production if pilot succeeds (we can map to discount tiers).

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), pricing_summary.pdf (summary PDF)

Thanks - I will track updates in HubSpot and share a revised MAP when I have your edits. If it helps, I can elevate the pricing ask to my manager for a provisional discount to keep the timeline.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa - thanks for the follow-up and the MAP draft. A few quick questions / edits from procurement and clinical ops: 

1) Milestone edits: can we move the target for 'Security review' to 3/18 and 'Environment setup' to 3/22? Our SecOps needs an extra weekend to pull evidence.
2) Pricing: procurement asked whether discounts are available for an annual commit vs pilot-only. We also want to understand if Redwood offers credits for professional services (onboarding / CSE support).
3) PO process: we are likely to need a PO + standard redlines - procurement@acuityhealth.com is copied.

If you can provide a proposed discount schedule tied to committed ARR or a one-time credit for onboarding, that would help us move faster. Also can you confirm SOC 2 date and provide the auditor contact?

Thanks - I can confirm milestone date edits by EOD tomorrow after a quick sync with SecOps.

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Mar 2026 13:40:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: MAP draft & post-call recap - pricing approval request

Marissa / Aditya - forwarding the thread and adding a short pricing recommendation for exec review.

Summary / recommendation:
- AcuityHealth is a mid-market health system with clear potential for expansion across clinics. Pilot ~5k q/mo -> with successful pilot could become a $150k ARR account in first year.
- Ask: procurement is requesting discount/credits for onboarding.

Recommendation: provisional approval to offer a 15% one-year discount on list pricing if AcuityHealth commits to $150k ARR within 60 days of pilot close. In addition, offer a $15k onboarding credit to be applied to first invoice for CSE support. This keeps the economics favorable and accelerates close.

Rationale: competitive win; predictable revenue; relatively low engineering lift for Private deployment with Redwood support.

Attachments: pricing_approval_request.pdf

Lauren - VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Hi Erin - appreciate the quick turnaround and the milestone edits; we can move Security review to 3/18 and environment setup to 3/22 as you suggested - I'll update the MAP and re-send.

On pricing/credits: Lauren in Sales Ops has proposed a provisional package (15% one-year discount + $15k onboarding credit) tied to a $150k ARR commit within 60 days of pilot close. I have routed this to our pricing approver and expect an answer by end-of-day Friday (2026-03-06). If approved, we'll document it in the MAP and reflect in the SOW.

SOC 2: Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report is available; I'll share the auditor contact and a copy once procurement confirms asset sharing NDA.

I'll update HubSpot and share the revised MAP (updated targets per your note) shortly. Let me know if procurement needs anything else to accelerate.
